hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.nix) nix fmt -- "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.nix) git add -- "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

cmdline=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmdline" | grep -qE '(^|[; &|])nix (build|eval)([ ]|$)|nix-instantiate'; then running=$(pgrep -x nix 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$running" ]; then reason="Another nix process appears to already be running (PID(s): $running) - this machine is RAM-constrained, confirm before running another."; printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"%s"}}' "$reason"; fi; fi
